    • getAlreadySentExtraCertsToUpStream

      public Set<org.bouncycastle.asn1.cmp.CMPCertificate> getAlreadySentExtraCertsToUpStream()
      Returns the set of extraCerts already sent to the upstream peer for this transaction. The set is lazily initialized and mutable, allowing callers to add entries as certificates are sent upstream.
      Returns:
      a non-null mutable Set of upstream-known CMPCertificates

    • setAlreadySentExtraCertsToUpStream

      public void setAlreadySentExtraCertsToUpStream(Set<org.bouncycastle.asn1.cmp.CMPCertificate> certsKnownToUpstream)
      Replaces the set of extraCerts already sent to the upstream peer. A defensive copy is created to avoid external mutation of internal state. If certsKnownToUpstream is null, the internal set is reset to an empty set.
      Parameters:
      certsKnownToUpstream - the new upstream-known certificates, or null to reset the set to empty

    • getAlreadySentExtraCertsToDownStream

      public Set<org.bouncycastle.asn1.cmp.CMPCertificate> getAlreadySentExtraCertsToDownStream()
      Returns the set of extraCerts already sent to the downstream peer for this transaction. The set is lazily initialized and mutable, allowing callers to add entries as certificates are sent downstream.
      Returns:
      a non-null mutable Set of downstream-known CMPCertificates

    • setAlreadySentExtraCertsToDownStream

      public void setAlreadySentExtraCertsToDownStream(Set<org.bouncycastle.asn1.cmp.CMPCertificate> certsKnownToDownstream)
      Replaces the set of extraCerts already sent to the downstream peer. A defensive copy is created to avoid external mutation of internal state. If certsKnownToDownstream is null, the internal set is reset to an empty set.
      Parameters:
      certsKnownToDownstream - the new downstream-known certificates, or null to reset the set to empty
